SWSE.Name: Name
SWSE.DamageThresholdHint: Damage equal to or greater than the threshold moves the target -1 step on the condition track.
SWSE.SecondWindAboveHalf: You are above half your HP. Second Wind normally requires half HP or less. Use anyway?
SWSE.Rested: Rested: second wind and Force powers recovered; healed HP equal to level.
SWSE.SkillsHint: Click a skill to roll (Shift+click opens options: bonus, Force Point, take 10/20). * = armor check penalty.
SWSE.ArmorCheck: Takes armor check penalty when not proficient
SWSE.AttackHint: Click a weapon to attack: a dialog shows the options your feats and talents allow (Shift+click attacks directly). Target tokens (T) to compare against Reflex Defense.
SWSE.CustomModifiersHint: Bonuses from external sources (allies' talents, temporary effects…). Bonuses of the same type don't stack (except dodge and untyped).
SWSE.Label: Label
SWSE.KeyHint: Identifier used by automation (e.g. weapon-focus). Don't change it on compendium items.
SWSE.ModifiersHint: Applied automatically to the sheet. Value accepts formulas like @level or @classLevel.elite_trooper/2.

Skill.label: Skill
Skill.CriticalSuccessNote: Critical Skill Success: choose another skill; once before the end of your next turn, +5 competence on it.
Skill.SkillfulRecoveryNote: Skillful Recovery: gain 1 temporary Force Point for this skill until the end of the encounter.

Weapon.settingsHint: Format damage:shots separated by | (e.g. 3d4:1|3d6:5|3d8:10). Shown as an option in the attack dialog.

Attack.Title: Attack
Attack.Label: Attack
Attack.ChargeNote: Charge: −2 to Reflex Defense until your next turn.
Attack.AutofireNote: Autofire: 2×2 area; targets hit take full damage, misses take half (Evasion applied automatically).
Attack.InaccurateLong: Inaccurate weapons can't attack at long range.
Attack.BonusStepsNote: If it deals damage, the target also moves down the condition track ({list}).
Attack.DevastatingNote: Devastating Attack: target's damage threshold treated as {n} lower.
Attack.StunningStrikeNote: Stunning Strike: −1 extra step if damage exceeds threshold.
Attack.DisarmNote: Disarm: on a hit the target drops its weapon. On a miss, the target gets a free attack against you.
Attack.DisarmNoteSafe: Disarm: on a hit the target drops its weapon (no free attack on a miss).

Chat.ThresholdExceeded: Damage ≥ threshold ({dt}): −{steps} step(s) on the condition track.
Chat.OccupantsDamage: Occupants take {amount} damage (half the excess over the threshold).

Force.DamageHint: "tier" = roll the dice of the highest DC reached; or a fixed formula.
Force.AllSpent: All uses of this power are spent. Use anyway?
Force.Nat20: Natural 20: all spent powers are regained.
Force.NoEffect: Result below the lowest DC: no effect.
Force.DarkSideIncrease: Dark side power: Dark Side Score +1.
Force.Hint: Click a power to use it (Use the Force check). Circles show available uses.

Warn.NoGM: No GM connected to apply damage.
Warn.NoPowers: This character knows no Force powers.
Warn.MacroOwnedOnly: Drag items from a character sheet.
Warn.Persistent: Persistent condition: Recover can't be used.

Settings.HpMethodHint: How HP gained after 1st level is determined.
Settings.AbilityMethodsHint: Methods allowed in the creation wizard.
Settings.EnforcePrereqsHint: In the wizards, hide/block feats, talents and classes whose prerequisites aren't met.
Settings.AutoOpenCreatorHint: Automatically opens the wizard when a new character is created.
Settings.AutoFlatFootedHint: When combat starts, every combatant is flat-footed until their first turn (removed automatically).

CG.AbilitiesHint: Choose a method. Species modifiers are applied afterwards (step 2).
CG.CanReroll: Your scores are low: you may reroll.
CG.PickSpecies: Pick a species on the left.
CG.PickClass: Pick a class on the left.
CG.SkillsHint: Class skills only. Count = class trained skills + Int modifier (min 1) + species bonus.
CG.TalentHint: Choose 1 talent from your class's trees. With Force Sensitivity you may choose a Force talent instead.
CG.PowersHint: Force Training: 1 + Wis modifier powers (min 1). You may pick the same power more than once.
CG.ReviewHint: When finished, items are added to the sheet and HP and Force Points are set to maximum.
CG.ConfirmReplace: This character already has species/class/feats/talents/powers. They will be replaced. Continue?
CG.ErrAssignAll: Assign a value to every ability.
CG.ErrDuplicateAssign: Each value can only be used once.

LU.AbilitiesHint: At 4th, 8th, 12th, 16th and 20th level, increase two different abilities by +1.
LU.SkillHint: Your Intelligence modifier increased: choose a new trained (class) skill.
LU.MulticlassHint: When taking a new heroic class, you gain one of its starting feats.
LU.FPReset: Force Points refreshed to the new maximum; +1 Destiny Point.
LU.PrestigeDefenses: Class defense bonuses: the best among your classes applies.

Vehicle.RefHint: Reflex = 10 + Dex + size + armor (or the pilot's heroic level, whichever is higher) + maneuver.
Vehicle.RechargeHint: System operator, 3 swift actions: Mechanics DC 20 → SR +5 (up to max)
Vehicle.RerouteHint: Engineer, 3 swift actions: Mechanics DC 20 → +1 step on the condition track
Vehicle.CrewHint: Drag characters onto the stations. Empty stations use the book's default crew (quality and BAB above). The pilot adds the vehicle's Dex and size to Pilot and Initiative; a heroic pilot's level may replace armor on Reflex.
Vehicle.WeaponsHint: Click a weapon to attack. Attack = operator BAB + vehicle Int (+2 if a trained pilot fires it); damage = (dice + ½ heroic level) × multiplier.
Vehicle.TractorNote: If it hits Reflex, make an opposed grapple check; if you win, the target is held (see tractor beam rules).
Vehicle.MissileLock: Locked missile/torpedo: if it misses, it may attack again next turn with the same bonus.
Vehicle.AttackRunNote: Attack Run: the vehicle takes −2 Reflex until your next turn (maneuver set on the sheet).
Vehicle.DropOnSlot: Drop the character onto a crew station.

Droid.AbilitiesHint: Droids have no Constitution: 5 abilities, 21-point buy, 15/14/13/12/10 package or 5× 4d6. In the species step pick degree and size (Medium or Small). Droids can't be Jedi.
Droid.SystemsHint: You start with a heuristic processor, two hands and basic locomotion (Medium: walking 6; Small: tracked 4). Spend up to 1,000 credits on locomotion, appendages and accessories; leftovers are lost (class credits come later).
Droid.SheetHint: Installed systems apply bonuses and speed automatically (e.g. best locomotion, improved sensors, claw unarmed damage).

SWSE.RecoverHint: 3 swift actions: +1 step on the condition track (not with a persistent condition)
SWSE.Recovered: Used the Recover action: +1 step on the condition track.

Effect.ConditionsHint: Click to toggle (same as the token HUD). Effects apply automatically: flat-footed/helpless/pinned lose Dex to Reflex; prone −5 melee; fighting defensively +2 (+5 trained Acrobatics) and −5 attacks; total defense +5/+10; grabbed −2 (except light/natural weapons) and no movement; cover and concealment adjust attacks against the character.
Effect.EffectsHint: Buffs and penalties with modifiers and a duration in rounds. Timed effects are removed at the start of the character's turn once they expire (requires a connected GM).
Effect.DurationHint: blank = permanent; 0 = until next turn; N = rounds
Effect.ModsHint: Modifiers (same targets and types as items). Bonuses of the same type don't stack, except dodge and untyped.

VC.Title: Vehicle combat
VC.Hint: Target (T) the enemy vehicle before using actions against it. Opposed checks use both vehicles' Pilot (assigned crew member or default crew).
VC.DogfightHint: Standard action (pilot): Pilot −5 opposed by the adjacent target's Pilot. Relentless Pursuit rolls twice.
VC.DogfightAttackHint: Standard action: opposed Pilot; if you win, one vehicle weapon attack (swift). If you lose, your gunners take −5 until your next turn.
VC.DisengageHint: Move action: opposed Pilot; win to leave the dogfight. Lose: gunners −5.
VC.RamHint: Full-round: Pilot −10 vs the target's Reflex; collision damage to both vehicles and occupants (half on a failure).
VC.HazardHint: Mobile hazard (asteroid, uncontrolled vehicle): 1d20 + size vs Reflex; Table 10-3 damage, half on a miss.
VC.AvoidNote: Reaction (pilot): Pilot DC 15 → everyone involved takes half damage (starship scale: no collision). Not when ramming on purpose.
VC.IncreaseSpeedHint: Swift action (trained pilot): Pilot DC 20; +1 square and +1 per 5 over. Failure: −1 step on the condition track.
VC.AllOutHint: Full-round: 4× speed (5× with Full Throttle) in a straight line; the vehicle loses Dex to Ref and gunners can't attack until your next turn.
VC.StopHint: Swift action: bring the vehicle to a stop (Dex −5 to Reflex). Click again to power up.
VC.NotInDogfight: You are not in a dogfight with {name}.
VC.RamMiss: Failed: half damage; the vehicle is pushed out.
VC.CollisionNote: Occupants: damage reduced by the vehicle's damage threshold unless it provides no cover (errata).
VC.NeedTrained: Requires a pilot trained in Pilot.
VC.SpeedFail: Failed: the vehicle moves −1 step on the condition track.
VC.SpeedUp: Speed increased by {n} square(s) until your next turn.
VC.AllOutMsg: All-out movement (×{mult}): up to {n} squares (character scale) / {s} (starship scale) in a straight line.
VC.NoAttackAllOut: After all-out movement, gunners can't attack until your next turn.
VC.OutsideDogfight: While in a dogfight you can't attack targets outside it.
VC.BattlefieldHint: Galaxy at War: the commander takes a standard action and the vehicle can't attack until the start of the commander's next turn. The effect lasts until the end of the vehicle's next turn for everyone in the radius (allies = same token disposition).
VC.BattlefieldNoToken: The vehicle has no token on the scene: the effect was applied to targeted tokens.

Talent.SpendFPFor10: Spend a Force Point for +10 (instead of +5)?
Talent.NextCheck: (for the next check; delete the effect afterwards)
Talent.ForceHazeNote: You and creatures up to your class level are hidden; anyone entering line of sight makes Use the Force vs Will to notice. Lasts up to 1 minute or until one attacks.
Talent.RageNote: +2 rage to melee attack and damage for {n} rounds; afterwards −1 step on the condition track (apply manually). No concentration skills.
Talent.InspireFearNote: Inspire Fear is passive: enemies of equal or lower level take the penalty on attacks and checks against you (apply it to them as an effect if you wish).
Talent.SituationalNote: (situational bonus: apply to the attack/defense when it applies)
Talent.FieldTacticsNote: Field Tactics: you and allies within 10 squares gain +10 cover (instead of +5) until your next turn — use the Improved cover status on them.
Talent.AssaultTacticsNote: Assault Tactics: you and allies deal +1d6 damage to the designated target until your next turn (use the extra damage field).
Talent.OutmaneuverNote: Outmaneuver: enemies in line of sight lose competence, insight, morale and dodge bonuses to attacks/Reflex until your next turn.
Talent.KnockdownNote: Knockdown Shot: if the aimed attack hits, the target falls prone (applied when you click apply damage).
Talent.RollTwice: Roll twice and keep the better (spends a Force Point)
Talent.DarkAdeptNote: Dark Side Adept / Embrace the Dark Side: you may reroll this check and keep the second result.
Talent.TelekineticPowerNote: Telekinetic Power: natural 20 — you may use this power again immediately as a free action.
Talent.NegatePenalty: Cumulative penalty: −{n} ({uses} use(s) since your last turn).
Talent.RedirectNote: Redirect Shot: you may make an immediate ranged attack with the deflected bolt.
Talent.ExtremeEffortNote: Extreme Effort: +5 on the next Strength check or Strength-based skill (Climb, Jump, Swim) this round.
Talent.GaWAfterHit: (use after the attack hits; target your allies)
Talent.NeedInitiative: Both you and the targeted ally must be in combat with Initiative rolled.
Talent.ExceptionalControlNote: Note the result: until the end of the encounter, as a reaction, replace an enemy's or ally's d20 roll in line of sight with it.
Talent.WordOfWarningNote: Choose an ally within 5 squares: once this encounter, as a reaction, their targeted defense uses your score.
Talent.TakeThePainNote: Reaction: when your protected ally would move down the condition track, you move down instead (adjust the tracks).
Talent.TeamEffortNote: Until the end of your next turn, enemies adjacent to you and your protected ally count as flanked (check Flanking on the attack).
Talent.EndGameNote: Check "End Game" in the attack dialog: the target's Damage Threshold is halved for this attack.
Talent.GuardianSpiritNote: The spirit appears within 6 squares: while within 12 squares, +1 morale on attacks and +2 on Use the Force and Will until the end of the encounter.
Talent.ChannelVitalityNote: −1 condition step: 1 temporary Force Point until the end of the turn.
Talent.UnswervingResolveNote: The fear/mind-affecting effect failed: 1 temporary Force Point until the end of your next turn.

Military.title: Rank and Privilege (Galaxy at War)
Military.hint: Automatic criteria come from the sheet (BAB, level, classes, Leadership talents, Skill Focus, Knowledge (tactics), Officer Candidacy Training). Use the manual adjustment for captures (+1/4 CL), valor (+2), conflicts (+1), failed missions, infractions etc. The command bonus applies to Persuasion with members of the organization.

Artillery.Title: Artillery strike
Artillery.Hint: Galaxy at War: choose the ammunition (Table 3-3) or a special order. Requires comlink, rangefinder and datapad. Target the center-square creature first, then those in the splash.
Artillery.OffTarget: Failed: the strike lands {n} square(s) off target (GM picks direction), in {delay} round(s).
Artillery.OnTarget: Coordinates confirmed: the strike arrives in {delay} round(s).
Artillery.TargetsHint: Center square (◎): full damage on a hit, half on a miss. Splash: half on a hit, none on a miss. Evasion applies.

Challenge.Title: Skill Challenge
Challenge.Name: Name
Challenge.ResolveHint: Select tokens and roll the skill, or type a result. Players can also roll from their sheet: the check card gets an "Apply to challenge" button for the GM.
Challenge.NoneActive: No active challenge. The GM can create a new one or load a book example.
Challenge.GMOnly: Only the GM can change the challenge.
Challenge.None: There is no active skill challenge.
Challenge.PickSkill: Pick a challenge skill (and a result).
Challenge.AskDC: Opposed DC or improvised skill: pick the difficulty or type the DC.
Challenge.RecoveryAsk: Beat the DC by 5 or more: remove a failure instead of earning the success?
Challenge.SecondEffortAsk: Does the hero make a sacrifice (condition step, damage or Force Point) to turn the failure into a success?
Challenge.SecondEffortNote: Second effort: apply the agreed sacrifice to the hero.
Challenge.AlreadyApplied: This check was already applied to the challenge.

EffectHint.antagonist: Failed checks don't count; each round the antagonist rolls and each success is a failure (use the + button).
EffectHint.catastrophic: Failing by 10 or more counts as two failures.
EffectHint.changingObjectives: Objectives and skills change after a number of successes.
EffectHint.closeCall: Only failing by 5 or more counts as a failure.
EffectHint.containment: Failed checks don't count; a failure happens only if nobody succeeds in a time increment (use the + button).
EffectHint.degenerating: 3 failures don't end it: each failure raises DCs one step, each success lowers them.
EffectHint.degreesFailure: Each failure has a consequence even if the challenge succeeds.
EffectHint.degreesSuccess: Every N successes grants a benefit.
EffectHint.extremeSuccess: Beating the DC by 10 or more counts as two successes.
EffectHint.individualEffort: Each hero must earn successes equal to the complexity.
EffectHint.opposedDC: The DC comes from an opponent's check or defense (the tracker asks).
EffectHint.recovery: Beating the DC by 5 or more may remove a failure instead of earning a success.
EffectHint.restricted: Some skills are forbidden or limited.
EffectHint.secondEffort: A failing hero may make a sacrifice (condition step, damage, Force Point) to turn it into a success.
EffectHint.timed: Failed checks don't count; successes must be earned before the round limit.

Poison.Recurring: Poisons attack every round (or day, for diseases) until treated: use the item again.
Poison.Spice: Instant second wind (+{heal} HP), +1 condition step and +5 Damage Threshold for 1 hour. Afterward: −5 Wisdom for 4 hours.
